description: This PHP source file defines the class `ParserModifyListView`, which extends `ModuleBuilderParser` and provides functionality for modifying, retrieving, and saving ListView configurations for modules in the SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for loading view definitions, managing default and available fields, validating fields, and updating layout files based on user input.

classes.name: ParserModifyListView
classes.description: A class responsible for parsing, modifying, and saving list view definitions for modules within the SuiteCRM platform, allowing dynamic customization of list views.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the parser with module data, loads existing list view definitions from files, and sets up internal state.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Returns the current language associated with the module.

methods.name: fixKeys
methods.description: Re-keys array entries to ensure each has a lowercase, 'name'-based key, simplifying later handling.

methods.name: getDefaultFields
methods.description: Retrieves the default fields for the list view, filtering out non-defaults and 'studio' hidden fields.

methods.name: getAdditionalFields
methods.description: Retrieves fields available for users to add to the list view, excluding default or reserved fields.

methods.name: getAvailableFields
methods.description: Retrieves fields that are not currently used in the list view but are available for inclusion.

methods.name: getFieldDefs
methods.description: Returns the field definitions of the module.

methods.name: isValidField
methods.description: Checks if a field is valid for inclusion in the list view based on various criteria such as visibility, type, and source.

methods.name: getField
methods.description: Retrieves the definition of a specific field by name.

methods.name: addRelateData
methods.description: Adds related module data to a field definition if applicable.

methods.name: _loadLayoutFromRequest
methods.description: Constructs the list view layout configuration from HTTP POST data obtained during user input.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the current list view layout configuration to the corresponding PHP file and clears the cache for immediate effect.
